title: The unexpected candidate
description: A strange noise interrupts an interview. A lunch box, a work bag and a message explain what happened.

title: We will miss you… apparently
description: Ben walks into his own farewell party, but he has no plans to leave his job. His notebook keeps the messages behind the surprise.

pieces.text: Cake icing: “WE WILL MISS YOU”.

pieces.transcript: Hi Charlotte. Can you explain the cake? I hadn’t told anyone I was leaving my job, because I wasn’t! I’d only said I was leaving the group chat. What did everyone think while I was standing there with the manager?

voice.script: Hi Charlotte. Can you explain the cake? I hadn’t told anyone I was leaving my job, because I wasn’t! I’d only said I was leaving the group chat. What did everyone think while I was standing there with the manager?

title: The ring at table twelve
description: A normal dinner in Paris turns into an unexpected proposal. Two table numbers and a waiter’s apology tell a different story.

pieces.text: A ring left beside the dessert at table 12.

pieces.transcript: I’m very sorry about the dessert. The kitchen had written table twenty-one, but I read it as twelve. Your friend was looking at the menu when I put the plate down. Did you actually say yes before I came back?

voice.script: I’m very sorry about the dessert. The kitchen had written table twenty-one, but I read it as twelve. Your friend was looking at the menu when I put the plate down. Did you actually say yes before I came back?

title: The gift that came back
description: A Christmas teapot looks familiar to more than one relative. Old cards and a reused box reveal its journey through the family.

pieces.text: The teapot is still in its old cardboard box.
